svg.aria-label: Tanzeel Ur Rehman builds AI agents for small businesses

g.text: I build AI agents that do the repetitive work of a
writes what to say back on a live call
audits the profile, fixes it, replies to reviews
answers customers in the app you already use
one post a day, comments, connection notes
finds the threads where your customers ask
scores new jobs and drafts the proposal
runs a Windows laptop from your phone
makes any video readable for an AI
